300:t_1:4.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「...So the closing ceremony got canceled after all.」

300:t_1:5.en:
$$風間$$
「Looks like the school is going to explain yesterday's incident.」

300:t_1:6.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「What about $$常磐$$? I heard there was a serious injury in yesterday's chaos...」

300:t_1:7.en:
$$詩織$$
「Still in the hospital. They said the worst is over, at least.」

300:t_1:8.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「...What about the Volunteer Club bunch?」

300:t_1:13.en:
$$詩織$$
「What about $$かなめ$$!? Is she with $$相良$$!?」

300:t_1:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「The one piloting that white AS yesterday... was me.」

300:t_1:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm a soldier in a mercenary unit, and I'm currently attached to a special forces unit of the $$地球連邦軍$$.」

300:t_1:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「I came to this school to protect $$千鳥かなめ$$ from an organization hostile to the one I belonged to.」

300:t_1:21.en:
$$風間$$
「What about $$兜$$ and the others!? Were all the Volunteer Club members mercenaries!?」

300:t_1:22.en:
$$宗介$$
「...That is not something I can speak of.」

300:t_1:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「But it's my fault the school got dragged into yesterday's battle.」

300:t_1:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$千鳥$$ was... taken away too...」

300:t_1:26.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「...You... can you say that in front of $$常磐$$...?」

300:t_1:28.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Quit screwing around! $$常磐$$ is still in the hospital! What the hell did you come back here for, strolling in like nothing happened!?」

300:t_1:30.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Stay out of it, $$風間$$! This guy...!」

300:t_1:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「I just wanted to say it...」

300:t_1:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「I will bring $$千鳥$$ back, no matter what.」

300:t_2:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...It's been a week since we got here already...」

300:t_2:6.en:
$n
「The emergency repairs on $$ジェニオン$$ are finally done. We can set out tomorrow.」

300:t_2:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The transmissions I intercepted during the day didn't pick up anything that looked like it.」

300:t_2:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone except us, in that $$時空震動$$...」

300:t_2:11.en:
$n
「It'll be all right, Miss $$スズネ$$. Wherever they got sent, knowing those guys, they're sure to be safe.」

300:t_2:12.en:
$n
「Besides, they must be looking for us too. There's no way that AG would leave $$ジェニオン$$, their trump card, lying around.」

300:t_2:14.en:
$n
「Until we get a grip on the situation, we won't go too far. We'll make this island our base camp. There's fresh water here, and plenty of plants and animals.」

300:t_2:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...You're full of life, aren't you. Is it because you can put your $$ビーストハンター$$ experience to use?」

300:t_2:16.en:
$n
「Doing everything you can to survive is the duty of every living thing, and its right as well.」

300:t_2:24.en:
$n
「I was wondering... if $$宗介$$ is safe...」

300:t_2:26.en:
$n
「It's not just $$宗介$$... I was thinking about everyone in $c... and about this world, too.」

300:t_2:27.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Even though we don't know what will happen to ourselves...?」

300:t_2:28.en:
$n
「I can manage what's mine to manage if I act on it myself.」

300:t_2:29.en:
$n
「But when it comes to other people... all I can do is wait...」

300:t_2:30.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're positive even in a situation like this...」

300:t_2:31.en:
$n
「It was Miss $$スズネ$$ and everyone else who taught me that.」

300:t_2:33.en:
$n
「Everybody gets down sometimes. So for now, I'll protect you, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

300:t_2:34.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Ever since you boarded $$ジェニオン$$, $n, you've been protecting me the whole time.」

300:t_2:35.en:
$n
「That's not true. I'm the one who's been protected.」

300:t_2:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Protecting, and being protected... I think that's what being partners is.」

300:t_2:37.en:
$$スズネ$$
「In my case, a teacher's sense of responsibility gets added on top, though.」

300:t_2:38.en:
$n
「But the special teaching practicum is over now, isn't it? The closing ceremony was last week.」

300:t_2:39.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then from now on, will you call me $$スズネ$$?」

300:t_2:41.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...If we can't find everyone, shall we just stay here as the Adam and Eve of this island, the two of us?」

300:t_2:44.en:
$n
「It's not that, but I'm not mentally prepared...!」

300:t_2:47.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm joking. Do you feel a little better?」
